3,617 likes, 29 comments - labourlawadvisor on October 20, 2026: "Patients’ Rights are Human Rights

The NHRC Charter of Patients’ Rights lays out 17 rights every patient should know:

1. Right to Information: Know your illness, treatment and costs in a language you understand.

2. Right to Records and Reports: Access your case papers, reports and discharge summary.

3. Right to Emergency Care: Basic emergency care cannot be delayed for advance payment.

4. Right to Informed Consent: Risks must be explained before any hazardous procedure.

5. Right to Confidentiality: Your health information and dignity must be protected.

6. Right to a Second Opinion: Consult another doctor, with your records shared without extra cost.

7. Right to Transparent Rates: Get displayed rates, itemized bills and fair pricing of medicines.

8. Right to Non-Discrimination: No bias based on illness, religion, caste, gender, age or origin.

9. Right to Safety and Quality Care: A clean, safe environment and care that meets accepted standards.

10. Right to Choose Treatment: Pick among available options, or refuse after understanding the consequences.

11. Right to Choose Pharmacy or Lab: Buy medicines and get tests from any registered provider.

12. Right to Proper Referral: Referrals must serve your interest, not commissions.

13. Right in Clinical Trials: Consent, confidentiality and compensation for harm.

14. Right in Biomedical Research: Ethical approval, consent and protection for participants.

15. Right to Discharge: No patient or body can be detained over a bill dispute.

16. Right to Patient Education: Learn about your condition, rights, insurance schemes and how to complain.

17. Right to be Heard: File complaints and expect a written response within 15 days.

Know your rights. Ask questions. Speak up.

#patient #hospital #medical #lla".
